headline: Willowfield Trust: four product issues shown live; reimbursements stuck in Processing with a 1–2 hour promise

suggested_routes.label: Customer follow-up
suggested_routes.rationale: An existing customer demonstrated four issues; one blocks payments and has a time-bound commitment.
suggested_routes.output: Customer follow-up (owner: Team member A, stated). Most urgent: reimbursements released but stuck in "Processing". Team member A said "I expect an update or resolution in an hour or two, and I will inform you" (turn 19); check whether that update was sent. Then send one status message covering all four issues, and confirm the attachment workaround in writing (turn 13).

suggested_routes.label: Internal / product / vendor note
suggested_routes.rationale: Three reproducible defects need product/engineering tickets with the steps the customer demonstrated.
suggested_routes.output: Defect tickets: (1) the payment description edit is saved but the old description still displays (turns 2–7; screenshots captured). (2) The Recreate payment screen does not accept an attachment; workaround via Invoice inbox → Review (turns 8–15); the workaround does not resolve the defect. (3) Mark as paid carries the previous item's amount into the next item (turns 21–25). Also: reimbursement payments stuck in Processing for more than one user (turns 17–19).

evidence.quote: Yes, it is still the old description.
I have captured screenshots of that behaviour. I will get it checked today. I do not have an explanation for it yet.
It uploads here. This route works
The workaround does not mean the direct upload issue has been resolved.
It happened for another user too, though that instance was resolved later.
evidence.supports: Processing issue affected more than one user.

evidence.quote: I expect an update or resolution in an hour or two, and I will inform you when they confirm.
The amount from the previous item appears in the next one.
I will send the details to the team, get their confirmation and come back to you.

concise_output: A support session where an existing customer (Willowfield Trust) demonstrated four issues. Reimbursements are stuck in Processing, with a promised update within 1–2 hours. A description edit does not persist. Attachments fail from Recreate payment (workaround found). Mark as paid carries the previous amount forward. This transcript arrived late, as revision 2.
what_established: All four issues were reproduced on screen-share; one workaround exists (attachments); Team member A committed to report each issue and return with confirmation, with a 1–2 hour expectation on the Processing issue.
what_not_established: Root causes, whether funds actually left the account ("appear to have been released"), how many payments or users are affected, or whether the 1–2 hour update happened.
next_action: Verify the Processing update was delivered; raise three defect tickets with the reproduction steps; send the customer one consolidated status message.
uncertainty: This analysis reflects revision 2, the first revision with usable text.
